'''Zhixiu''' is an NPC in {{Location|Jinzhou}}. She can be found in the Archive Room, inside the [[Huaxu Academy]].

During the event [[By Moon's Grace]], Zhixiu is an NPC in [[Taoyuan Vale]] for [[Swim, Gulpuff, Swim]].

==Quests and Events==
===Event Appearances===
* [[By Moon's Grace]]
{{Quests and Events|Zhixiu}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Zhixiu''': There are some docs Mr. [[Xiangli Yao|Xiangli]] put together for us, sort of like... extra homework? A little gift from our resident genius.
:'''Zhixiu''': He's always making breakthroughs so quickly, we struggle to keep up.
:'''Zhixiu''': But we have to keep up. If you can't even try to keep pace, why bother being an academic?
{{Dialogue End}}
===Event Dialogue===
====By Moon's Grace====
{{Dialogue Start}}
;(First interaction)
:'''Zhixiu''': Hi, Rover! Remember me?
:{{DIcon}} You're a researcher from Huaxu Academy...
::'''Zhixiu''': Yes, that's me. I'm glad you still remember.
:{{DIcon}} Sorry, I don't recall.
::'''Zhixiu''': Oh don't worry, I'll introduce myself again. I'm Zhixiu, a researcher at Huaxu Academy. We met before, remember?
:'''Zhixiu''': Long story short, interested in trying out "Swim, Gulpuff, Swim"?
:'''Zhixiu''': In this game, participants race as Gulpuffs.
:'''Zhixiu''': Jinzhou's Echo technology might not be as popular as Rinascita's, but I think it has great potential.
:'''Zhixiu''': Entertainment is key here. Plus, it's good for collecting research data.
:'''Zhixiu''': Besides this swimming challenge, I've got some other events lined up. Hope you enjoy them, Rover.
----
:'''Zhixiu''': Gulpuffs are so soft... Hmm, they do have an interesting texture.
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Zhixiu''': Using Echoes for entertainment could be pretty cool.
::'''Zhixiu''': At Huaxu Academy, we focus on what works best in practice.
::'''Zhixiu''': But... not everything we study has to be practical, I guess. Research that brings laughter also has its value.
::'''Zhixiu''': What do you think, Rover? Aren't Gulpuffs just adorable?
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
